Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly equated the historical title "Western Roman Emperor" with the modern country "Italy." While the sources correctly identified Anthemius as the "Western Roman Emperor of Italy," the Western Roman Empire was a political entity that spanned multiple regions (including parts of modern France, Spain, North Africa, and Italy) and did not correspond to the modern nation-state of Italy. The Planner prematurely concluded the task was complete by selecting "Italy" without verifying if Anthemius was specifically born in Italy or if the question required a modern country mapping that might differ from his political title. This is a contextual error where historical political boundaries were confused with modern geographical ones.
